dedupe_keys.name: opendelve open source dynamic evolving levee environment global river delta flood protection

description: openDELvE is a worldwide database of flood-protection measures on river deltas, compiled from various national and open sources by researchers at Utrecht University. It has three spatial layers, the delta boundaries, the leveed areas and the levee line features, plus an index table that documents the sources, method and decisions for each delta polygon, with metadata, a report, an ArcGIS geoprocessing toolbox and a Python import script. It is available as a free download from DataverseNL as shapefiles and KMZ files with a CSV index, under a CC BY 4.0 licence; version 3.2 was released in January 2023 after first publication in March 2021. Coverage is global for river deltas. Caveats: levee completeness varies by delta with the quality of the underlying sources, the dataset description does not mention crest heights or design standards, and the layers are a static snapshot. Simulation uses: mapping which delta areas are protected when assessing flood hazard exposure, resilience and sea-level-rise adaptation. Related records: the US National Levee Database (data-usace-national-levee-database) and the Dutch primary flood defences (data-netherlands-primary-flood-defences-nbpw).
